display_name: Income Tax Ordinance s 66, separate calculation for spouses: who may claim it, where each spouse's income goes, property income under (b), the credit points s 66(c) gives in a separate calculation, and the common-source gate of (d)

run.method: one session working alone from BRIEF.md, per the encoding-a-subject skill; no sub-agents; no independent test pass

language.note: Every module starts @lang en; identifiers are English. Hebrew source strings are quoted in comments, copied from the deposited file.

source.note: Unofficial Hebrew Wikisource consolidation, as amended at retrieval. Hebrew is authoritative.

tax_years: From 2024. The last amendments to s 66 (תשפ״ג־6, תשפ״ד־3) apply from tax year 2024 per ITA circulars 2024-000012 and 2024-001090 (NOTES.md sections 3 and 7). Every top-level rule refuses a tax year before 2024, because the earlier text is not in the source bundle. A tax year after 2026 is a projection of the text as at 2026-10-06.
scope: s 66 in full: (a)(1)-(3), (b), (c)(1), (1A), (2), (3), (4) with (a), (a1), (4A), (5) with (a)-(c), (6), (d)(1)-(2); spent text ((c)(4)(b)-(d), (c)(5A), (e)) carried as inert stubs. Incorporated and encoded: the paragraphs of the s 1 definition of income from personal exertion (as an enumeration) and the s 40(b)(3) definitions of year of birth and year of majority. NOT encoded, taken as inputs or GIVENs: s 65 (the consolidated calculation is named as an outcome, not computed), s 64B (who is the registered spouse), the counts under ss 34, 35, 36, s 37's conditions, the value of a credit point (s 33A), the tax on income from personal exertion (ss 121 ff.), and the classification of income.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test author and no adversarial refuter has been run. The 165 satisfied assertions were written by the encoder, from the source, in the same session as the rules, so they share its reading; 23 of them transcribe the Israel Tax Authority's own published tables.

forks.F1: s 66(d)(1): the common-source gate read as on the COUPLE (subsection (a) does not apply to them at all), not on the common-source income alone, which s 64B(b) suggests.
forks.F2: s 66(a)(1) proviso: a sum on commuting a pension (s 1 def. para (6)) is not a 'קיצבה'.
forks.F3: s 66(a)(2): equal non-zero incomes from personal exertion are answered by neither sentence; the encoding refuses.
forks.F4: s 66(a)(2): the comparison uses each spouse's whole income from personal exertion, including a pension the (a)(1) proviso keeps out of the separate calculation.
forks.F5: s 66(a)(3): 'ילדו' is the registered spouse's own child; a child of the other spouse alone is not reached.
forks.F6: s 66(a)(3): s 65's exception for assets from inheritance or bodily-injury compensation is not applied.
forks.F7: s 66(b) proviso: only the (a)(1) calculation of the spouse who is not registered is 'other income for which a separate calculation is made'; the registered spouse's claimed (b) income is always calculated alone.
forks.F8: s 66(c)(1A): not shut by the (d) gate, which names subsection (a) only.
forks.F9: s 66(c)(4)-(6): 'the woman' and 'the man' presuppose a mixed-sex couple; the encoding refuses for a couple of the same sex.
forks.F10: s 66(c): a credit provision it does not name (39A, 39B, 40A-40D, 44, 45, 46, ...) is refused, not defaulted.
forks.F11: s 66(c)(4)(a1): the birth-year election is the mother's and does not reach a step-mother's points under (4A).
forks.F12: s 66(c)(4A), (6): only a widowed partner's children count, not a divorced partner's.
forks.F13: s 66(c)(1A), (4), (5): the children's credit is capped at the tax on income from personal exertion; the ½ under s 36A is not.
forks.F14: s 66(a)(3) income stays on the registered spouse and does not move with the (a)(2) pool.
forks.F15: s 66(a)(3): a child who turns 18 during the tax year is outside it.
forks.F16: s 66(c) governs both spouses' calculations once (a)(1) gives a separate calculation.
forks.F17: s 66(c)(4), (5): no maintenance or custody condition on the children.
forks.F18: s 66(c)(1A): 'בן זוג' includes the registered spouse.
